title: New Application Ideas of Dynamics 365 Business Central (2025 OCT)
summary: A curated list of user-suggested feature ideas and improvements for Dynamics 365 Business Central covering development, finance, general functionality, inventory, manufacturing, projects, purchasing, sales, and administration. The post aggregates requests from the community to highlight potential enhancements across multiple business areas.
key_points: Covers diverse areas including data migration, AL development enhancements, financial reporting, user experience improvements, and module-specific features
Includes technical requests like temporary variables in posting routines, base64 encoding methods, and FlowField refresh mechanisms
Features business process improvements such as recurring journal allocations, subscription billing enhancements, and warehouse management optimizations
Addresses localization needs like GLN number field length and tax reporting engine configurability
Encompasses user interface requests like keyboard shortcuts, selection modes, and edit area sizing

quotes.text: Would any of these ideas improve Business Central? Here is a list of some of them.
quotes.why_it_matters: Frames the post as a collection of community-sourced improvement suggestions for the platform
